parameters.fetchXml:
<fetch version="1.0" output-format="xml-platform" mapping="logical" distinct="false">
  <entity name="new_timesheetcost">
    <attribute name="new_timesheetcostid" />
    <attribute name="new_name" />
    <attribute name="createdon" />
    <attribute name="new_isexpense" />
    <attribute name="new_description" />
    <attribute name="new_billunit" />
    <attribute name="new_candidateid" />
    <attribute name="new_ratetypeid" />
    <attribute name="new_assignmentid" />
    <attribute name="new_billtaxtypeid" />
    <attribute name="new_assignmentrateid" />
    <attribute name="new_timesheetid" />
    <attribute name="new_units" />
    <attribute name="new_date" />
    <attribute name="new_bill" />
    <attribute name="new_billtotal" />
    <attribute name="new_pay" />
    <attribute name="new_paye" />
    <attribute name="new_expensepaytotal" />
    <attribute name="new_paytotal" />
 <attribute name="new_start" />
 <attribute name="new_finish" />
 <attribute name="new_break" />
    <order attribute="new_date" descending="false" />
    <filter type="and">
      <condition attribute="new_timesheetid" operator="eq" uitype="new_timesheet" value="@{outputs('GetTimesheetRowbyID')?['body/new_timesheetid']}" />
 <condition attribute="new_assignmentrateid" operator="not-null" />
    </filter>
  </entity>
</fetch>

<fetch distinct='false' mapping='logical' aggregate='true'> 
  <entity name="new_timesheetcost">

     <attribute name='new_units' alias='new_units_sum' aggregate='sum'/> 
      <attribute name='new_paytotal' alias='new_paytotal_sum' aggregate='sum'/> 
     <attribute name='new_assignmentrateid' alias='new_assignmentrateid_alias' groupby='true' /> 
    <filter type="and">
      <condition attribute="new_timesheetid" operator="eq" uitype="new_timesheet" value="@{outputs('GetTimesheetRowbyID')?['body/new_timesheetid']}" />
 <condition attribute="new_assignmentrateid" operator="not-null" />
    </filter>
  </entity>
</fetch>
